NonQualityRecipes.label: Apply to Non-Quality Recipes
NonQualityRecipes.description: Extends work memory to recipes that do not produce quality items, such as cooking or refining bills.

Penalty.label: Cold Start Penalty
Penalty.description: Sets the initial speed penalty. The maximum speed bonus is always half of this penalty.

WarmupSpeed.label: Warm-Up Speed
WarmupSpeed.description: Controls how quickly repeated work builds momentum.
WarmupSpeed.slider.label: {0}x

DecayDelay.label: Decay Delay
DecayDelay.description: How long a pawn can stop working before work memory starts to decay.
DecayDelay.slider.label: {0} h

DecaySpeed.label: Decay Speed
DecaySpeed.description: Controls how quickly work memory decays after the delay expires, relative to warm-up speed.
DecaySpeed.slider.label: {0}x

LongTermScale.label: Consolidation Scale
LongTermScale.description: How much repeated work is needed before memory becomes permanent, as a multiple of the recipe's reference work. Higher means mastery takes more repetitions.
LongTermScale.slider.label: {0}x

LongTermCurvature.label: Consolidation Curvature
LongTermCurvature.description: Shapes the diminishing returns of permanent memory. Lower values give a heavier tail, where early repetitions count more and full mastery is approached very slowly.

LongTermMaxFraction.label: Permanent Ceiling
LongTermMaxFraction.description: The highest permanent speed a pawn can reach through repetition alone. At the lowest setting the permanent layer is disabled.
